chapter_title: Learning Experience Design and Software Technology
title: Comparative Software Audit
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting comparative software audit to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Build a comparative audit matrix that scores every candidate tool on the same task-derived criteria
Distinguish a pass-or-fail gate from a weighted dimension and apply gates before reading totals
State a recommendation bounded by its named context (learners, budget, constraints) plus the re-entry condition that would change the winner
Document a bounded AI/software support move with an accepted and a rejected suggestion, such as using BigAL to attack the criteria rather than rank the tools

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
